name: Hand-played kill switch
desc: Passes audio untouched until the Kill footswitch is held, then mutes with a near-hard edge: a played toggle stutter

refs.why: Tom Morello flicks between a dead and a live pickup to stutter notes

notes: Depth 0: the pattern never cuts; only the momentary Kill (on a footswitch) mutes. Smooth 0.3 ms keeps the clack without a pop
